review_highlights.comment: Dr Westbay is quite a nice teacher.  She is passionate about what she teaches and is willing to offer help to students when needed.  However, she is very unclear about the assignments, and sometimes tend to grade according to effort rather than the actual quality of the piece of work.

Dr. Westbay is such a great teacher! I suppose I am somewhat biased because I got an A in her class, but I thought she was very fair and straight-forward. She actually gave honest criticism about my papers instead of meaningless compliments followed by miserable grades. Take her class, it's great!

review_highlights.comment: Professor Worger is a nice person, he really likes what he is teaching and his lectures are inspiring. This class is about African history and it is definitely not boring. We get to choose our own country to study and I had a lot of fun.

EASY GE. Honestly, this was my primary reason for taking this class. I was looking to boost my GPA and this was one of the most recommended classes. Aside from that, this class was soo incredibly interesting! Worger and his amazing team were so educated on the topics and really taught the truth of Africa. I am so glad I took this course when I did!

Professor Worger is such a nice guy! Very easy online class and accommodating for Spring 2020, our final paper was canceled! There are weekly quizzes which are pretty easy as long as you watch the lectures and do the reading (Sometimes a lot of reading btw) and occasional assignments every other week that took me less than an hour. Def recommend!

At the beginning of the quarter your study list will give you a couple of books that will be required for the class, don't buy them! He gives you the pdf version of everything you need to read (except one of the chapter books but you can easily find it for free online). This class is easy as long as you watch the lectures and browse the readings
Reading material is interesting. Prof. Worger is a good lecturer, very knowledgeable. His class discussions are fun!

analysis.name: Linda Van Leuven
analysis.verdict: Good teaching but expect to put in the work
analysis.confidence_detail: Based on 41 reviews, fairly reliable

review_highlights.comment: Had no clear grading system; when asked about expectations, would give no answer and tell you to "find your way", yet still gave bad grades; didn't use half of reading marked as required to purchase; smelled really really bad. Stay as far away from this joke as possible.

We buy 6 bks for this class and don't really use them, then we have to buy a wkbk from her that should cost $6 but she charged 47 for.  No respect for our time: assignments by email on Sat., due on Sun. Random irrelevant assignments on the side. When concerns are brought to her, she's "teaching us to live with uncertainty." No clear grading policy.

Very interesting reading material, however Dr. Van Leuven is extremely biased and refuses to allow actual discussion if students disagree with her point of view. She can be hostile, scream, and grade down based on personal opinion rather than academic merit. Frustrating even if you agree with her. Only mind blowing if you have no prior knowledge.

Worst instructor I've ever had for any class ever, and it's my major. Was meant to be an Urban Society course, but what we learned did not match the course description at all. You never get any of your work back, so unless you ask the TA you won't know your grade. Readings are nauseating. Assignments are useless. Who gave her a Ph.D. anyway?

LVL teaches topics for life.  For once, courses that teach you about your personal self, and daily interaction.  What is going on in seemingly overlooking interactions.  Once you graduate, you might think back and REALLY appreciate his style, topics, and simplicity.  Just do your work, think, make an effort, and this class will change you.
